title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Summoning and Defeating Velgar
author: Kurigo
description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds continues our journey through Ashenfall as we finally climb Velgar’s tower and use Cathan’s Challenge Horn to summon the dragon. Armed with the Anti-Dragon Shield, melee weapons and magic, we fight through Velgar’s attacks before bringing him down and completing this major part of the Dragon Slayer story. Afterwards, we return to the Wise Old Man, receive new rewards and unlock the next stage of our Dragonblight equipment progression.

00:00 - Climbing Velgar’s Tower
02:20 - Solving the Saradomin Statue
03:59 - Summoning Velgar
04:20 - The Fight with Velgar
06:23 - Switching to Fire Magic
09:02 - Defeating Velgar
10:20 - Dragon Slayer Rewards
11:06 - Preparing for What Comes Next

About This Series

This RuneScape: Dragonwilds series follows our complete journey through Ashenfall as we explore, build, fight, craft and learn the game naturally. Each episode focuses on meaningful progress while keeping the adventure easy to follow from beginning to end.

Stay happy and healthy.
